intro hs
have h_finite_union : (⋃ i, s i).Finite := 
  Set.finite_iUnion_iff.1 (hs) (fun i => (s i).Finite) (Finite.finite_univ)
have h_encard_eq_sum : (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard := 
  by rw [Set.encard_eq_card, Set.card_iUnion_disjoint hs, Set.card_encard, Finset.sum_encard]
exact h_encard_eq_sum
